text:

Applicant Tracking Systems
The Next Generation Talent Acquisition Platform
Peoplise is integrated cloud-based recruitment, onboarding management, and applicant tracking system (Analyse) designed to assist internal HR teams. Our recruiting platform accelerates recruiting with an easy-to-use ATS, social recruiting capabilities, mobile-optimized branded career and position microsites, video screening, online interview, analytics, onboarding, and seamless integration with other HR systems.
Analyse is more than Applicant Tracking Software (ATS). With more than 200 built-in assessments from leading vendors, video interviewing and online interview modules, chatbots, and more.
You not only get an award-winning ATS but also digitize all your process steps on a single platform. Create and post jobs, assess, manage and analyse your talent with smart automation, notification, filtering, and reporting tools. No more switching between apps, solutions, and vendors. Analyse is all you need for all your recruitment necessities.
With Peoplise you can:
Create your position in ATS
Push position to Peoplise
Design your position flow (Social Media Campaign, Video Screening, Assessments, Online Interview, etc.)
Socialise, Analyse and Harmonise candidates
Feed all assessment and experience data back to ATS
Marsh: Leaders in Talent Assessments & Proctoring Solutions
